findings.title: Pod resolves names with the node's DNS
findings.cause: container client exits because api.kd-hostnetwork-dns.svc.cluster.local does not resolve: the pod runs on the host network with dnsPolicy ClusterFirst, which for such pods means the node's resolver, and that resolver knows no Services; its log says: "wget: bad address 'api.kd-hostnetwork-dns.svc.cluster.local'"; Deployment client has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container client exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 5 times
last lines of container client's log (run that exited)
the pod sets hostNetwork: true and dnsPolicy ClusterFirst
evidence.command: kubectl get pod client-5fb5b6c577-qpnzg -n kd-hostnetwork-dns -o jsonpath='{.spec.hostNetwork}{" "}{.spec.dnsPolicy}'

findings.fix: Set dnsPolicy: ClusterFirstWithHostNet in the pod spec, so a pod on the host network uses cluster DNS.
